# Zengel et al. (2022) marsh erosion data

- File: `zengel2022_griidc_erosion.xlsx` (originally "GRIIDC data - erosion 1-12-2022.xlsx").
- Dataset: Zengel, S., Nixon, Z., Weaver, J., Rutherford, N., Bernik, B. M., Michel, J. "Marsh shoreline erosion
  and supporting data in areas affected by the Deepwater Horizon oil spill." GRIIDC, published 2022-02-22,
  doi:10.7266/VF524143, UDI R6.x813.000:0007. Licence CC0 (public domain).
- Paper: Zengel et al. (2022) Accelerated marsh erosion following the Deepwater Horizon oil spill confirmed,
  ameliorated by planting. Scientific Reports 12:13802, doi:10.1038/s41598-022-18102-1.
- Downloaded 2026-11-11 from https://data.griidc.org/download/dataset/4762 (zip, 66,890 bytes).
  SHA-256 of the xlsx: e1615f1317dc21c006529ad517d536ee52da5a5b5b97d346aa3ca97e47fe86d0.
  GRIIDC lists a checksum (b0915ad6...) and size (66,842 bytes) that match neither the zip nor the xlsx as
  served; the file could not be verified against it.
- Read with pandas/openpyxl directly from the sheets; no values were typed in or read from figures.
